data.narrative:
Blykalla, a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Janne Wallenius and Peter Szakalos, has raised $60M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 11 peers across the Nuclear Energy sector—3 public entities (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private companies including Valar Atomics, Helion, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Stage-progression methodology is applicable here, using total capital raised ($60M) as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement in this sector. This approach yields an implied valuation of $114M. A peer-median method was not feasible; while 6 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, similar-valuation-tier) returned insufficient overlap—fewer than the three datapoints needed for reliable triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given nuclear energy's distinct capital intensity and development timelines.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $97M (low) to $131M (high), centered on $114M. The single-method reliance introduces material uncertainty; the range reflects ±15% sensitivity around the stage-progression result. Key risks to valuation include regulatory pathway clarity, capital intensity requirements for commercialization, and the nascent state of comparable exit multiples in advanced nuclear. Tightening the range would require either additional narrow-stage comps or evidence of Blykalla-specific technical or market differentiation.
